question: Under what conditions does the DJI Matrice 30T start Failsafe Return to Home after losing the remote controller signal, and when might it be unable to avoid obstacles?
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

intake.focus: Matrice 30T lost-link Failsafe RTH and obstacle avoidance
intake.reason: Question asks for guidance from manuals/incident reports about lost-link behavior (Failsafe RTH) and obstacle avoidance limits for the DJI Matrice 30T.

brief.short_answer: On RC loss, the aircraft starts RTH using Advanced RTH per the RTH settings, and it will remain in RTH even if the RC signal returns. The RTH altitude should be set higher than any obstacle, and if RTH is canceled after the warning, the Intelligent Battery may not have enough power to land safely. The manual does not specify conditions under which Failsafe RTH would fail to avoid obstacles after RC loss.
